description: Kaduwela Municipal Council - Named the Roads in G. N. Divisions 478 Thalahena South as "Waana Place", 477 Thlangama North A as "Gemunu Place". 488/B Thunandahena as "Jaya Mawatha", 472A Pahala Bomiriya as "Cinnamon Garden Place", 474/A Raggahawatta as "Raggahawatta Lane", 492/B North Battaramulla as "Lieutenant Colonel Sumith Dhammika Perera Mawatha" and 476 Malabe Southas "Botheju Lane"
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with the naming of roads and provides detailed descriptions of property boundaries and land assessments. It involves land and property-related matters (specifically road naming with property identification), which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized administrative matters that would take precedence.
